name: Ore Fist
description: Close a fist heavy with ore and strike one foe so that the blow carries the weight of stone.

name: Ironstone Plate
description: Raise a plate of stone and iron from the ground before the user to take a blow.

name: Ore Sense
description: Reach down through the earth and feel where ore lies and how rich it is, for the user.

name: Ore Stride
description: Raise a block of ore under the foot and ride it forward one great pace.

name: Oreshard
description: Break a lump of ore from the ground and shatter it into shards that fly at a foe.

name: Stonebind
description: Close stone and iron about a foe's legs and hold them fast in the ground.

name: Gravelmail
description: Wrap the body in a coat of gravel and iron rings which takes blows like mail.

name: Orepierce
description: Drive a stake of hardened ore up from the ground through a foe's boots and shield.

name: Ore Hammer
description: Raise a hammer of solid ore from the ground and bring it down on a foe or on the guard he holds.

name: Seamed Armor
description: Clad the body in armor of stone laced with seams of iron that mend as they crack.

name: Ironstone Crush
description: Bring a mass of iron-veined stone down upon a single foe in a crushing blow that flattens guard and armor together.

name: Ore Colossus
description: streams: Metal + Earth. Raise a giant of ore and stone that stands, strikes and guards at the cultivator's will, as neither stream could alone.

name: Flesh Iron
description: Turn muscle and skin to iron-hard flesh that is still quick to move.

name: Sinew Wire
description: Snap the tendons of an arm taut as wire and lash out with the forearm.

name: Marrow Reading
description: Read through metal qi how dense a foe's bones and plate are and where they are weakest.

name: Ironbone Strike
description: Strike with a forearm whose bone has been packed with metal until it breaks plate.

name: Steelmuscle
description: Wind metal qi through the user's own muscles to harden and quicken them for a long exchange.

name: Boneblade
description: Edge the outer bone of the forearm with metal qi and cut as with a sword.

name: Marrow Sheath
description: Turn a blade aside with a limb whose bone is lined with metal.

name: Ironsinew Surge
description: Surge metal qi through every muscle at once, doubling the user's strength and speed for a short time.

name: Flesh Blade
description: Turn the whole arm into one living blade and cut through a foe's weapon and guard.

name: Living Blade
description: Become a single edge of living steel, body and weapon joined, and cut through everything in the line of a charge.

name: Living Steel
description: streams: Metal + Body Path. Fold the body path's tempered flesh into the metal affinity until skin, bone and blade are one steel that heals as it fights.

name: Root Spike
description: Drive a spike of metal qi into the ground and let it rise beneath one foe's feet.

name: Plate Root
description: Sink the user's own plate into the ground by roots so it cannot be shoved aside.

name: Ore Hearing
description: Listen through the roots to the ground's iron and learn what treads or digs near the user.

name: Root Step
description: Drive a root forward under the earth and pull the user along it a long stride.

name: Spikefall
description: Raise a field of iron spikes from the ground beneath the foes before the user.

name: Rootbind
description: Wrap iron roots about a foe's legs and drag him down.

name: Ironsoil
description: Pack the soil about the user with iron so that it rises to take blows from below and either side.

name: Rootspear
description: Shoot a lance of iron root up through the earth into a foe at a distance.

name: Rising Spikes
description: Raise ranks of spikes one after another across a wide space, driving the foes back.

name: Armored Earth
description: Clad the ground round the user in a thick iron crust that turns the force of heavy blows.

name: Trembling Iron
description: Shake the iron in the ground so the footing of every foe in reach is thrown into confusion.

name: Iron Quake
description: Strike the ground with a Core-driven shock that cracks it open in iron-edged fissures through all the foes in front of the user.

name: Ironroot Spear
description: streams: Metal + Earth. Drive a root of the Core's iron deep and raise the earth about it into one great spear that no shield of either stream could stop.

name: Bone Edge
description: Cut with a ridge of bone sheathed in steel qi along the outer arm.

name: Steelframe Guard
description: Close the steel frame round the ribs and spine against a blow.

name: Frame Reading
description: Run the frame's qi into a foe's weapon and armor and read the strain that each can bear.

name: Steelframe Stride
description: Let the frame take the whole weight of the body in one springing stride.

name: Steelframe
description: Wear a steel frame over the body that bears the weight of heavy blows and holds the user upright.

name: Frameram
description: Drive the user's steel frame forward in a single charge that bowls over a foe in heavy armor.

name: Jointlock
description: Lock a foe's elbow and knee with a hard grip of steel qi so that the limb cannot bend.

name: Frame Overdrive
description: Send the Core's qi through the frame to lend the user's blows more power and the user's body more speed.

name: Titan Frame
description: Raise the frame to the height of a giant, each plate a bastion against the strokes of several foes.

name: Wiresinew Lash
description: Lash out with steel-wired sinew along a limb stretched past its natural length.

name: Crushing Frame
description: Seize a foe in the arms of the frame and crush him, raising the grip as he strains.

name: Colossus Frame
description: Become a colossus of steel that shrugs off blows and strikes back with the weight of the whole frame.

name: Steel Titan
description: streams: Metal + Body Path. Unite the Core's steel with the tempered body path until the cultivator stands as one titan whose strength and defense are those of neither alone.

name: Titan Ironquake
description: streams: Metal + Earth. Bring the steel titan's fist down upon the earth so that a ring of iron-edged ground rises and breaks outward through everything near.
